submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV illumination, monoclinic BiVO4 (Eg ~2.4 eV) barely absorbs, so I focused on Cu-rich vanadates (Eg ~1.9–2.0 eV). XRD on idx 8 showed a BiVO4-dominated pattern. XRD on idx 57 and 27 showed Cu–V oxide phases. Index 57 (Bi 0.11, Cu 0.575, V 0.31) gave the highest photocurrent measured, 2.3e-7 A. That is about 3x idx 16 and 23x idx 30.

rejected.reason: V-rich/Bi–Cu–V region near the BiVO4 side; 8e-8 A, lower than 57
XRD shows BiVO4-dominated phase, which absorbs poorly at 2.06 eV; not measured for merit
